run_human_pose_pipeline: run the ego4d human pose estimation pipeline via launch_main.py with argparse CLI options
run_task_with_submitit: run the human pose task using submitit executor for GPU cluster job submission
run_task_locally: run the human pose task locally with run_type set to local mode
run_task_with_flow: run the human pose task using flow-canary or flow-local job launcher
run_task_with_custom_work_dir: run the human pose task with a custom work_dir for resuming previous jobs
